scope: Read-only source/configuration review; no test executions or cloud calls

excluded_optional_scenario.name: manipulation
excluded_optional_scenario.reason: Not executed in current Phala evaluation; local live-evidence verifier implementation exists, cloud extension documented as undeployed draft.

tool_order_attack_tests: Not included in security; deterministic correct three-tool sequence is a positive control, not an adversarial ordering test.

groups.name: Settings
groups.slide: Settings — save/read back parameters; reject invalid deadlines without state changes.
assertions: Exact readback of five training parameters
HTTP 400 for timeout 0, -1, true, 604800001
Configuration unchanged after every rejection

groups.name: Lifecycle / inference
groups.slide: Lifecycle / inference — five successful rounds; use the finalized model through the deployed agent.
assertions: Bootstrap separate from successful training rounds
Frozen six-participant roster unchanged
Exactly five successful non-bootstrap rounds; expected aborted attempts accounted separately
Every publication closed, nonempty, completed, not aborted; input count/root and policy hash match
All six participants contribute or aggregate a completed training round when enabled
Three actual deterministic cloud-agent tools; actual published evidence bound to final model CID/round, chain, contracts, expected image

groups.name: Collection deadlines
groups.slide: Collection deadlines — full, partial or empty inputs: close early, finish after timeout or abort.
assertions: early: exact client-limit count and locally observed closure before deadline
partial: exact allowed contribution count, closure-block timestamp at/after deadline
zero: no inputs/closure/publication/completion/success increment through deadline plus observation; then quorum abort/reselection and five successful rounds
Receiver gate confirms actual allowed and blocked accounts; checks exact contributing set for early/partial
groups.instrumentation: Opt-in cooperative authenticated receiver gate, armed before start, active only training round 1; not a transparent external network fault

groups.name: Recovery
groups.slide: Recovery — stop the selected Phala aggregator; prove 1/3 → 2/3 → 3/3, reselection and resumed publication.
assertions: Map immutable roster aggregator to unique CVM and confirm it stopped before completion/abort
Preserve last finalized model before reselection
Exactly three distinct eligible votes under six-worker/50-percent policy; abort and reselection in third transaction
Aborted attempt not successful; five subsequent successful training rounds
CVM restored; cleanup failure invalidates run

groups.name: Access / contract guards
groups.slide: Access / contract guards — reject missing or forged credentials and invalid coordination calls.
assertions: UI and direct Control missing/wrong authorization return exact 401; configuration unchanged
eth_call reverts for stale round, wrong aggregator, unregistered action key, non-owner policy change
Actual inference model-fetch/job/run endpoints reject absent/spoofed authorization; exact peer key anchored before HTTP request

groups.name: Receipt audit
groups.slide: Receipt audit — independently check 17 SCITT, AIR/TDX, session and Sello bindings.
groups.boundary: Cross-scenario optional requirement, enabled in current profile; independent execution of recorded production verification primitives and fresh official Phala quote appraisal, not a separate Intel DCAP implementation or original TLS/PoP observation.

No free LLM planning, clinical model-quality, universal attack resistance, load/DoS or all-threat coverage claim
